listen_addr.description: IP address the Gearman server listens on (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

listen_port.description: Port number for the Gearman job server.

pid_file.description: Full path to the PID file.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (use '-' to log to stderr, or empty string to disable file logging).

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging. Higher levels include more detail.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads. Set to 0 for automatic detection (recommended).

max_threads.description: Maximum number of worker threads (upper bound for internal thread pool size).

queue_type.description: Backend storage for job queue persistence: 'memory' (fastest, volatile), 'sqlite' (local file), or 'mysql' (remote database).

sqlite_db_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file (only used when queue_type='sqlite').

mysql_host.description: MySQL server hostname or IP address (only used when queue_type='mysql').

mysql_port.description: MySQL server port (only used when queue_type='mysql').

mysql_user.description: MySQL username for the Gearman database (only used when queue_type='mysql').

mysql_password.description: MySQL password for the Gearman user (only used when queue_type='mysql').

mysql_db.description: MySQL database name (only used when queue_type='mysql').

data_dir.description: Directory for persistent data (used for SQLite journal files or other state).

timeout.description: Seconds before a client or worker is considered dead and disconnected.

daemonize.description: If true, run Gearman as a background daemon. Set to false for foreground debugging.

allow_clients.description: List of allowed client IP addresses or CIDR blocks. Use '*' to allow all.

use_syslog.description: If true, disable logging to syslog (note: 'no-log' disables ALL logging; this setting controls syslog specifically).

job_limit.description: Maximum number of concurrent jobs a worker may handle (set to null/undefined to disable limit).

status_port.description: Port for the HTTP-based status endpoint (set to 0 to disable).
